info.description: Property-rental platform backend. Provides OTP-based authentication, multi-step listing wizard, media upload workflow, amenity catalogue, and an admin moderation panel.
info.title: Flickey Go API

get.description: Returns recent administrative audit log entries.
Returns a list of listings, optionally filtered by status.

parameters.description: Listing status filter (pending, active, rejected, suspended, archived)
parameters.name: status

200.description: List of listings with host details

get.description: Returns full listing details for moderation.

post.description: Approve, reject, or suspend a listing. Transitions state and records an audit log.

get.description: Returns counts of total users, listings, pending verifications, active listings, etc.
Returns user/listing reports optionally filtered by status.

post.description: Marks a moderation report as resolved or dismissed, recording note and reason.

get.description: Returns a list of users, optionally filtered by role and status.
Returns a user's details and their listings.

post.description: Applies a warning, temporary block, or ban to a user. Records an audit log.
Changes a user's role (guest, host, admin, moderator, support).

get.description: Returns verification requests optionally filtered by status.

parameters.description: Verification status filter (pending, approved, rejected, changes_requested)
parameters.name: status

get.description: Returns the details of a single verification request.

post.description: Approves, rejects, or requests changes for a verification request. Updates user status and logs audit entry.

get.description: Returns categorized amenities, optionally filtered for a specific housing type (apartment, house, manor).

parameters.description: Filter by housing type: apartment, house, manor
parameters.name: housing_type

post.description: Sets first name, last name, and optional email for a newly registered user. Transitions status from pending_profile to active.

parameters.description: Profile fields (first_name and last_name required, email optional)
parameters.name: body

409.description: EMAIL_TAKEN – email already used by another account

post.description: Creates or finds a user by phone and returns tokens without OTP verification. **Only available when ENVIRONMENT=dev.**

404.description: NOT_FOUND – endpoint disabled in non-dev environments

post.description: Revokes the current refresh token and clears the HttpOnly cookie.
Revokes all refresh tokens for the current user across all devices.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile. Automatically promotes guest → host if the user already has published listings.

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh_token cookie (or Authorization header in dev) for a new access token and rotates the refresh token.
Sends a one-time password to the provided phone number and returns a challenge ID used in the verify step.

parameters.description: Phone number (E.164) and optional return URL
parameters.name: body

post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP against the challenge ID. On success issues an access token in the body and sets an HttpOnly refresh_token cookie.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR – missing fields or wrong OTP format

get.description: Returns geocoded address suggestions and coordinates for a given search query (proxied to Photon OSM with Redis caching).
Returns all currently published listings. No authentication required.

post.description: Initialises a new multi-step wizard draft with the property type. Returns the draft ID and current step number.

get.description: Fetches the full state of a listing draft. Only the owning host can access it.

patch.description: Sets name, area, floor, guest count, rooms, beds, and bathrooms. All fields required. name: 10–100 chars; square: 10–1000 m²; floor/total_floors: 1–150; max_guests: 1–50; rooms/beds: 1–30; bathrooms: 1–20.
Attaches 5–15 uploaded media UUIDs to the draft. All referenced media must belong to the current user and be in uploaded status.
Attaches one or more amenity IDs from the amenity registry to the draft.

parameters.description: Array of amenity ID strings (at least 1)
parameters.name: body

patch.description: Sets price per night, currency, minimum nights, check-in/check-out times (HH:MM format), and house rules (allow_children, allow_pets, allow_smoking, allow_parties, deposit_required, with_invoicing).
Sets the free-text description for the listing. 30–5000 characters.

post.description: Finalises a completed 6-step draft and creates a published listing pending moderation. Requires the Idempotency-Key header (UUIDv4) to prevent duplicate submissions.

get.description: Returns all published (and pending) listings owned by the authenticated host.
Returns the public-facing details of a specific listing by UUID. No authentication required.
Retrieves raw media bytes directly from local dev storage. **Dev only.**

put.description: Uploads file content directly to local development storage without S3. **Dev only.**

post.description: Validates content type and file size, creates a media record with 'pending' status, and returns a presigned upload URL.

parameters.description: Media upload request parameters (content_type and file_size_bytes)
parameters.name: body

200.description: Presigned upload URL and media metadata

post.description: Verifies uploaded object existence, size, and binary magic bytes in storage. Marks media status as 'uploaded'.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of notifications for the authenticated user.

post.description: Marks all unread notifications for the user as read.

get.description: Establishes a persistent SSE stream to deliver real-time notifications to the client. Token can be passed in Authorization header or as ?token= query param.
Returns total count of unread notifications for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Marks a specific notification as read.

details.description: Details is present only for VALIDATION_ERROR responses.

CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly refresh token cookie set by /auth/verify-otp and rotated by /auth/refresh.
CookieAuth.name: refresh_token
